finding: The material is a teaching handbook with simulated examples and is not an empirical study of a real intervention.
evidence: The introductory business cases use generated or six-row examples and no source data are included.
next_action: Use it for method training and code scaffolding; do not cite it as evidence of a business effect.

finding: SMD < 0.1 is presented as a universal pass threshold, but it is a heuristic and does not prove exchangeability.
evidence: The balance section labels every below-0.1 feature as passed.
next_action: Report pre/post balance, overlap, match rate and unmeasured-confounding risk; do not equate balance with causal identification.

finding: The ATT significance test uses an independent-sample t-test even when observations form matched pairs and controls may repeat.
evidence: ttest_ind appears once and ttest_rel appears zero times.
next_action: Use paired analysis for one-to-one pairs or cluster-robust/bootstrap inference that reflects the matching design.

finding: The 1:N matching example does not document how often a control can be reused or whether reuse changes matched-set counts.
evidence: NearestNeighbors returns two controls for every treated row without an explicit reuse ledger.
next_action: Report unique treated/control counts replacement policy and effective matched-set size.

finding: The caliper loop selects each control separately and does not mark a selected control as used.
evidence: The loop calls argmin over all controls for every treated row.
next_action: Add a used-control set or state that replacement is intentional; report unmatched treated units.

finding: Common-support and overlap diagnostics are not implemented in the shown code.
evidence: The handbook contains no executable common-support or overlap check.
next_action: Add propensity-score density and overlap checks and exclude unsupported regions under a documented rule.

finding: The sensitivity section checks alternative matching settings but does not quantify sensitivity to unmeasured confounding.
evidence: No Rosenbaum bounds or E-value appear in the handbook.
next_action: Add a formal unmeasured-confounding sensitivity analysis before production use.

finding: The placebo code substitutes an equal-weight mean of other controls instead of re-estimating a full synthetic-control model for each placebo unit.
next_action: Describe it as a simplified benchmark or implement full placebo re-estimation with RMSPE-ratio inference.
